## E2 exact comparison prepared; real execution approval pending — 2026-11-04

Follow-up to E1: the investigator directs preparing the original-weight encoder comparison. This does not authorize real parameter loading or accept dev4 scientifically.

**Exact proposed plan SHA-256:** `eb6d30fc31217dee57c9200fcfcff982ebbee0facb12fdeff3b6f9da3b92692b`. Same installed dev4 wheel `01fe4e125eca5decdca89f43e8925e8e969d3453b7a4da701be8e96e5e18dbe0`; no runtime/dependency changes. Source remains local/uncommitted.

- Selected original encoder: six JSON/seventeen numeric NPY files, 2,032,384 bytes; starter `7804df862872ccc6d09fe01c41bafbca194cfa31`, original `6590d2f4c2963f25d30669052a4c4a857e0e7279`. Current byte-only preflight matches all identities. Real parameter bytes are rehashed, never deserialized into arrays in preparation.
- Reference retains Python 3.8.20/TF 2.2.1/Keras 2.3.1/NumPy 1.18.5 (61 distributions and the eight known native metadata discrepancies); modern retains Python 3.14.7/Torch 2.15.0+cpu/NumPy 2.4.6 (41-distribution E1 borrowed-payload fixture).
- Fixed fixture SHA-256 `7dfd8672aeb359958bdbe04d6e2a3bbfc3e18d60ffe90675989ecaad8e024f3c`: 32 distinct structural token rows/36 occurrences, including homopolymer, length, zero, reversed/asymmetric controls and four duplicates. This is not a natural-peptide/biological benchmark.
- Five encoder evaluations per worker: full36, repeat36, reversed36, split18+18. **Ten evaluations total**, 144 submitted occurrences per worker. Mean/raw log-variance plus two intermediate taps in the same calls.
- Prospective new encoder criterion: elementwise `atol=2e-6, rtol=2e-5` against original, finite FP32 shapes, exact identical-input repeats and occurrence mappings, layout/duplicate numerical checks. This requires investigator approval before real outputs; it is not automatic transfer of E1 tolerance or biological equivalence.

**Construction finding:** in native Keras 2.3/TF2, original `random_normal((64,))` enters init_scope and draws an unused eager epsilon vector while building the discarded sampling branch. The proposed allowance explicitly includes **one 64-value construction noise draw**, plus native layer-initializer RNG/SVD before saved-weight assignment, within one legacy construction. No sampled latent z is fetched. The instrument observes the original call unchanged, checks endpoint ancestry and the actual pruned executable plus every function body for random operations, and checks executable identity before each evaluation. Graph inspection is not a runtime profiler claim. Modern calls preserve RNG state.

**Instrument is qualified artificially:** eight model-free tests pass with published Receptor 1.2.2/JUnit; the final dual-worker artificial case passes all five evaluations/layouts per implementation (4.03/3.13s, 361.4/268.1MiB sampled RSS). Earlier failed artificial instrument attempts and preliminary success remain retained with diagnosed causes: lost traceback, blocked optional uname fallback, incompatible forced graph mode, integer global learning-phase override, and a sandbox socket-test restriction. Corrections affect the instrument only; no provider was patched. There are zero real encoder evaluations.

Proposed host envelope: sequential workers, CPU 0/1, one numerical/inter-op thread, nice 10, 120 s each/240 s total, 4 GB task RAM intent, 2 GiB sampled process-tree RSS stop, 8 GiB virtual-address ceiling, MemAvailable floor 8 GiB, free task disk floor 1 GiB, output cap 128 MiB, no GPU computation/child commands/retry. Reuse existing qualified stdlib-only process supervision; no PeptideMT provider runtime dependency. Current host has 10 physical cores/20 threads, ~30.7GiB RAM/~15.4GiB available; dynamic guards run again before execution.

Owner records: `devguide/pytorch_encoder_E2.md`, `devguide/evidence/pytorch_encoder_E2_preparation.json`; instrument `ports/pytorch/devtools/encoder_parity.py`. Consumer: `devguide/hydramp_encoder_E2.md`, `devguide/evidence/hydramp_encoder_E2_preparation.json`. Full exact plan/artifacts remain local in `hydramp-encoder-E2-prep-7y8qhl7j`, retained through 2026-11-14.

Keep #8 open. Separate investigator approval of exact bundle/use, criteria, construction noise and host/call allowance is pending. No real-run authorization/attempt exists. D41/dev3, consumer artifacts and D35/M1–M8/selectors remain unchanged. No analogue, training, #7 filter fix, other family, release, commit/push or author contact. Consumer: https://github.com/uibcdf/peptidemt/issues/32.

## Encoder E2 prepared; exact-plan approval pending — 2026-11-04

Owner handoff: https://github.com/uibcdf/hydramp/issues/8#issuecomment-6633304777. Maintained consumer review: `devguide/hydramp_encoder_E2.md`; evidence: `devguide/evidence/hydramp_encoder_E2_preparation.json`.

The exact prospective plan SHA-256 is `eb6d30fc31217dee57c9200fcfcff982ebbee0facb12fdeff3b6f9da3b92692b`. It retains the same dev4 wheel, selected original 23-file encoder and both installed environments. Real parameter bytes match the retained asset manifest by raw-byte hashing; **no real parameter array is deserialized and no real encoder evaluation occurs**.

The fixture fixes 32 distinct token rows / 36 occurrences and proposes five encoder evaluations per worker: baseline, exact repeat, reversed order and two partitions. Ten evaluations total return raw mean/log-variance plus intermediate taps. Proposed elementwise diagnostic bands are atol=2e-6, rtol=2e-5, reviewed prospectively for this encoder. These structural inputs do not establish biological efficacy or natural-peptide generalization.

A relevant native behavior is now explicit: constructing the original sampling branch draws **one unused eager 64-value epsilon vector**, in addition to layer-initializer RNG/SVD. Its sampled latent is never fetched. The instrument verifies that the actual executable calculating the selected outputs contains no random operations. Modern calls preserve RNG state.

Eight model-free tests and the final artificial dual-worker case pass. The latter takes about 4.03 / 3.13 s and 361.4 / 268.1 MiB sampled RSS. Initial artificial instrument failures, causes and corrections remain retained; no provider component was patched.

Proposed execution: two sequential CPU workers, one numerical thread, CPU 0/1, nice 10, at most 120 s each / 240 s total; 4 GB task RAM intent, 2 GiB sampled process-tree RSS stop and 8 GiB virtual-address ceiling per worker; at least 8 GiB available host RAM and 1 GiB free task disk, output cap 128 MiB, no GPU computation or retry.

D42 still authorizes artificial preparation only. **Separate exact-plan bundle/use, criteria and host/call approval remains pending.** No real approval/attempt marker exists. Accepted dev3/consumer artifacts, all unfavorable historical evidence, D35/M1–M8 and both selectors remain unchanged. This issue stays partial/open; no analogue, training, other family, release or original-author contact is commissioned.
